async: The awaited Promise is the blocking Session.SendUserMessage call: it returns after the prompt (or queue operation) completes or fails; cancellation is the context.Context argument; no detached goroutine.
rationale: AgentSession.sendUserMessage(content, {deliverAs, expandPromptTemplates}) is Session.SendUserMessage(ctx, content, *SendUserMessageOptions): array content joins text parts with newline and passes images, expansion defaults to false, source is extension.

truncateToVisualLines(text, maxVisualLines, width, paddingX = 0, keep = "end") is TruncateToVisualLinesKeeping(text, max, width, paddingX, keep) with TruncateToVisualLines as the keep-end form with optional padding; the result is VisualTruncateResult{VisualLines, SkippedCount}.
